cases.name: Andrea J. Taylor Meek
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Andrea was a 1988 graduate of Hughesville High School.  She worked at the Red Rock Job Corps as a property coordinator.

She was a member of the Mildred American Legion Auxiliary. Andrea enjoyed socializing with friends and shooting darts and pool.  She especially enjoyed spending time with her beloved granddaughter, Andrea."

cases.narrative:
Taylor first shot his 60-year-old wife Linda with a rifle during a domestic dispute, he then fled— shooting at a passing truck— next he went to his 52-year-old sister,  Andrea Meek's home— whom he also shot dead— before stealing a four-wheeler and fleeing, yet again, according to the police. 

Three more vehicles and several homes were shot at, then Taylor found Zehing walking toward the hunting cabin on SR 239 north— he was shot and died at the scene.

cases.name: Linda L. Dendler Taylor
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Linda was a graduate of Bloomsburg High School, Class of 1980.  She had worked for many years as a customer service agent for numerous companies, most recently Alphabroder.  She was an avid reader.  Linda was a devoted mother and grandmother.  She was immensely proud of her family and loved spending time with them."
